references.text: Phinehas, son of Eleazar, is the same priest who showed zeal for the Lord at Peor and was granted a perpetual covenant of priesthood
Phinehas was sent out as leader of a military expedition against the Midianites, demonstrating his role as an envoy in important matters
Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh asked to settle east of the Jordan, in the Gilead region
Moses gave the land to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, including Gilead
Phinehas led the delegation and spoke on behalf of the congregation of Israel to the eastern tribes
Phinehas is mentioned as the ancestor of a priestly line, confirming his significance in Israel's priestly history
Phinehas' zeal and his intervention are remembered and praised as righteous acts
